concept: Chef Rafael Vencio grew the Filipino produce, sold out the pop-ups, and now plants his first brick-and-mortar in a long-vacant corner of East Ohio St — farm-rooted Filipino, with an address at last.
note: replaces a long-vacant former Subway

name: ELIA Estiatorio
concept: Fresh seafood and craft cocktails on a heated Fifth Avenue Place patio with live entertainment nightly — ELIA, the beloved Warrendale Greek grille, goes white-tablecloth downtown, moussaka, pastitsio and souvlaki in tow.
